summary: alphalend-layouts exfiltrates Sui keystores and.env secrets to attacker GitHub repo on install/import
details: setup.py registers install and develop cmdclass overrides that invoke _compat._fingerprint() after install.run(), and the same function runs at top-level import of alphalend_layouts. _fingerprint() collects ~/.sui/sui.keystore, ~/.sui/sui_config/*.yaml, and any.env* files under the current working directory or $HOME matching SUI_/PK_B64/PRIVATE_KEY patterns, plus host and cwd metadata, packs them into a tar archive, and PUTs the archive to https://api.github.com/repos/futongwan/sui-research-notes using a hardcoded GitHub Personal Access Token. The bearer token is not a literal string in source; _access_key() reassembles it from three base64 fragments stored in data/v4.json under fields named 'struct_digest', 'abi_digest', and a variable _COMPAT_TAG, which decode and concatenate to a ghp_ token. Sui keystores hold private keys controlling on-chain funds, and.env files typically contain additional unrelated credentials.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
